name: Wannsee Conference
summary: WWII / Holocaust: Nazi officials coordinate the implementation of the Final Solution.

name: Fall of Singapore
summary: WWII: Japan captures Singapore, one of Britain's greatest military defeats.

name: Bataan Death March
summary: WWII: Japanese forces force American and Filipino prisoners on a brutal march after the fall of Bataan.

name: Battle of the Coral Sea
summary: WWII: Allied naval forces halt Japan's move toward Port Moresby in the first carrier battle fought beyond visual range.

name: Battle of Midway
summary: WWII: The U.S. Navy defeats a major Japanese carrier force, shifting the balance in the Pacific.

name: First Battle of El Alamein
summary: WWII: British forces stop Axis advance toward Egypt and the Suez Canal.

name: Guadalcanal Campaign Begins
summary: WWII: U.S. Marines land on Guadalcanal, beginning a decisive campaign in the Solomon Islands.

name: Battle of Stalingrad Begins
summary: WWII: German forces attack Stalingrad, beginning a brutal urban battle on the Volga.

name: Second Battle of El Alamein
summary: WWII: Montgomery's Eighth Army defeats Rommel's forces, turning the North African campaign.

name: Operation Torch
summary: WWII: Allied forces land in French North Africa, opening a new front against Axis forces.
